description: LLM prompt upgrade to executive resume writer level ($500+) and add generic resume mode with coverage scoring. Rewrite all resume builder prompts with strategic positioning expertise. Add a 'generic resume' mode that optimizes for maximum coverage across all saved jobs. Add a coverage score showing what percentage of saved jobs' requirements the generic resume would satisfy.
steps: Rewrite the SYSTEM_PROMPT in src/app/api/resume/generate/route.ts with executive resume writer expertise. The prompt should emphasize: strategic career narrative positioning, value propositions tied to business outcomes, executive branding language, quantified impact statements with context, industry-specific terminology elevation, leadership and influence framing for senior roles. Remove generic/formulaic language. This is a $500+ executive resume writer's perspective.

Rewrite the system prompt in src/app/api/resume/project/[id]/build/route.ts (the highlight recommendation prompt) with executive-level strategic thinking. Focus on: selecting highlights that tell a cohesive career narrative, prioritizing business impact over task descriptions, recommending edits that reframe accomplishments as strategic contributions, evaluating highlight strength based on executive positioning value.

Rewrite the system prompt in src/app/api/resume/project/[id]/improve/route.ts (the bullet improvement prompt) with executive resume writer expertise. Focus on: transforming task descriptions into impact statements, adding strategic framing (led vs did, architected vs built, drove vs managed), suggesting where quantification would elevate the statement, using industry power verbs appropriate to seniority level.

Rewrite the system prompt in src/app/api/resume/project/[id]/cover-letter/route.ts with executive-level cover letter writing. Focus on: opening with a compelling value proposition not a generic statement, weaving a strategic narrative about career trajectory, connecting specific achievements to the company's strategic priorities, closing with a confident forward-looking statement. Keep to 250-300 words (half-page).

Add 'generic resume' mode to src/app/api/resume/generate/route.ts: When the request body includes { mode: 'generic' } (no specific targetRole required), instead of tailoring to one role, analyze ALL saved jobs to find the most commonly demanded skills/requirements across the user's job library, then generate a resume that maximizes coverage across all saved positions. The response should include a coverageScore field.

Create src/app/api/resume/coverage/route.ts - POST endpoint that accepts { resumeContent: string } (the generated resume text) and evaluates what percentage of saved jobs' key requirements it satisfies. For each saved job, extract the top skills/requirements and check how many are represented in the resume. Return: { overallScore: number (0-100), jobScores: [{ jobId, jobTitle, company, score, matchedSkills[], missedSkills[] }], topGaps: string[] }.

Update src/app/resume/page.tsx to add the generic resume mode. Add a toggle or button next to the target role input that says 'Generic Resume (optimize for all jobs)'. When this mode is selected, hide the target role input and show explanatory text. After generation, display the coverage score prominently with a breakdown showing per-job match percentages.
Run npm run build to confirm all changes compile correctly.
acceptance_criteria: All four LLM prompts (generate, build, improve, cover-letter) are rewritten with executive resume writer expertise - no generic filler language, strategic positioning focus
POST /api/resume/generate with { mode: 'generic' } generates a resume optimized for maximum coverage across all saved jobs
POST /api/resume/coverage accepts resume text and returns per-job coverage scores
The resume page UI has a toggle for generic mode and displays coverage scores after generation
Cover letter prompt enforces 250-300 word limit (half-page)
All prompts gracefully degrade if no API key is set
npm run build completes without errors
verification: npm run build exits with code 0
